startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: A site, a sitemap URL, or a list of URLs.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: list: check the given URLs. sitemap: expand sitemaps first. crawl: follow same-site links.

maxPages.title: Max URLs
maxPages.description: Stop after this many unique URLs.

checkExternal.title: Check external links
checkExternal.description: Crawl mode: also check links that point to other sites (they are not crawled).

debugNetwork.title: Debug network
debugNetwork.description: Log connect details for failed requests (host, attempt, reason, error classes). No headers, bodies, paths or query strings.
